pr.title: fix(adhd): wire interactive prompts into launch and profile flows
pr.body:
## Summary
- Fixes the ADHD interactive prompt helper so show-more actually expands beyond the initial max-three choices.
- Wires the helper into live launcher role selection while preserving the existing boot-sequence UI.
- Uses the same progressive prompt pattern for profile wizard MCP selection.

## Test Plan
- python -m json.tool task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-ADHD-INTERACTIVE-PROMPTS-001.json >/dev/null
- python -m jsonschema -i task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-ADHD-INTERACTIVE-PROMPTS-001.json docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json
- python -m pytest tests/unit/test_wizard_interactivity.py tests/unit/test_launcher_wizard.py tests/unit/test_profile_wizard.py -q
- python -m pytest tests/test_cli.py::TestCLI::test_start_command_role_dry_run tests/test_cli.py::TestCLI::test_start_command_profile_dry_run -q
- git diff --check
- pre-commit run --files <changed files>

@codex review
@gemini
@copilot

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, item state, and existing prompt, launcher, and profile wizard behavior.
validation: get_context 885c68a0 reports ready or work state with no unsatisfied dependencies.
Existing non-test callers of InteractivePrompts and live launcher/profile prompt paths are identified before editing.

steps.task: Fix progressive disclosure in InteractivePrompts without changing max_choices default.
requirements: Initial action/menu views must show at most three real choices plus an explicit show-more affordance.
The show-more affordance must terminate by expanding the selectable set instead of recursively repeating the same limited view.
KeyboardInterrupt handling and missing questionary behavior must remain deterministic.
validation: Focused tests cover max-three initial action selection and expanded show-more selection.

steps.task: Wire InteractivePrompts into live launch/profile flows without affecting non-interactive runs.
requirements: Launcher role selection should use max-three progressive disclosure and then preserve boot-sequence wizard updates after a role is selected.
Profile wizard MCP selection should use the same max-three progressive helper for recommended/minimal/full/custom options.
Existing dry-run and explicit --role paths must not prompt.
